Author: Kathy Auteberry (fork of AnoMech by Anomek)
Name: FluffySim
Description: Practice FFXIV Ultimate mechanics inside the game, solo with seven simulated party members or together in multiplayer. Covers Dragonsong's Reprise (Elemental) and Futures Rewritten (Mana), plus The Epic of Alexander (Mana), The Omega Protocol P1–P4 (Elemental) and Dancing Mad (Mana) in beta, with God Mode, Pause and Restart for repeated attempts. Based on AnoMech by Anomek and contributors.
Punchline: Ultimate practice for DSR, FRU, TEA, TOP and Dancing Mad, solo or multiplayer.
Changelog:
Changed
- Elements boss positions: Once the Epic and Fated Heroes are assigned, the tanks hold both bosses in the middle.
- Limit Cut needs a tank LB3: The Cyclones after Vacuum Wave now kill the party unless a tank LB3 covers them.
- Black Hole follows Yan's tethers and Stomp-a-Mole: With Kefka as north, Attack 1 now pulls the first tether counter-clockwise; the second set stays clockwise, Attack 1 first.

Fixed
- ISSIS invulns are enforced: In Elements the Exdeath tank must invuln the Thunder III buster, and in Black Hole (and in Limit Cut, if chosen) the tank a Thunder III plan names must invuln its set.

Author: Kathy Auteberry (fork of EchoXIV by ssalazar217)
Name: Kotodama
Description:
Kotodama is a personal fork of EchoXIV focused on fast, accurate Japanese<->English chat translation for Japanese PF raiding and everyday social chat, powered by a local LLM.

Based on EchoXIV by ssalazar217: https://github.com/ssalazar217/EchoXIV
Punchline: Japanese<->English chat translation with a local LLM. Fork of EchoXIV.
Changelog:
Incoming messages
- English lines containing an auto-translate phrase (brb 【Bio】, missing 【Reprisal】) no longer get a [KT] line that only moves the phrase to the front.
